## Quick-Reference Auth Pattern

- Session claims: cookie-based JWT via `jose`; helper `getSessionClaims()` / `requireAuth()` in `apps/client-dashboard/src/lib/auth*.ts`.
- Claim shape: `auth.sub` = userId (no separate `userId` field).
- Org scope: every query must filter by `organizationId` — see models below for which ones carry it.
- Admin dashboard: separate `isAdminAuthorized()` gate (`ADMIN_ACCESS_KEY`), not the same session system as tenant apps.
- Soft deletes: filter `deletedAt: null`; never hard-delete (see models below).
